functions.description: Short-circuit all events that are NOT of sourcetype cisco:estreamer:data
Rewrite events with required fields only.

Parse the container JSON into fields
[mr-trim] Remove labels

pipelines.description: [meter-reader-demo] Kubernetes: drop debug lines, then trim pod labels. Steady ratio ≈ 0.70.

functions.description: Syslog pre-processing: strip the RFC 3164 header and keep the sender as host (mrd_syslog_pre)
Set Splunk metadata, cut _raw to the PAN CSV body, drop every other field (pack pan_traffic step 2; host now comes from mrd_syslog_pre)
Extract the PAN-OS 11.x TRAFFIC fields (pack pan_traffic step 3)
Event time = generated_time (pack pan_traffic step 5; the device time-zone lookup is omitted, times are UTC)
Remove future_use, redundant times and fields the Splunk TA does not extract (pack pan_traffic step 12)
Reserialize to CSV in the Splunk TA field order; removed fields become empty cells (pack pan_traffic step 13)
Keep _raw and the Splunk metadata only (pack pan_traffic step 15)

pipelines.description: [meter-reader-demo] Palo Alto TRAFFIC: syslog pre-processing (mrd_syslog_pre) + the pan_traffic pipeline of the Dispensary pack "Palo Alto Networks" 1.1.8 (remove future_use and unused fields, reserialize for the Splunk TA).
[meter-reader-demo] Passthrough: no functions. Raw streams run through this at full price until "Apply the pack".

Parse the JSON access log into fields

Serialize the remaining fields back into _raw as compact JSON
Keep only _raw and _time so the byte estimate is the serialized event

functions.description: Extract the VPC Flow Logs v2 fields (space-delimited)

pipelines.description: [meter-reader-demo] AWS VPC Flow: extract the v2 fields, drop NODATA/SKIPDATA, aggregate per minute by src, dst, dstport and action (sum bytes and packets, count flows).

Serialize the remaining fields back into _raw as compact JSON
Keep only _raw and _time

pipelines.description: [meter-reader-demo] Windows XML, aggressive ("Go aggressive"): parse, drop RenderingInfo (the Message repeats EventData), provider GUID, correlation and empty values, flatten to compact JSON (Cribl Docs "Reducing Windows XML Events", documented 34–70%).

functions.description: Parse _raw XML to a JSON & remove fields with values in brackets

User.ID to User from JSON

Pull only digits from TokenElevationType
EventID to EventCode
Serialize fields into _raw
Keep only the following fields at top level, and use next Code function to remove duplicates
